description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing Stripe customer using their unique customer ID.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the Stripe customer to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'cus_'.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

name: retrieve_customer

city.description: City, district, suburb, town, or village.
city.title: City

line1.description: Address line 1, such as the street, PO Box, or company name.
line1.title: Line1

line2.description: Address line 2, such as the apartment, suite, unit, or building.
line2.title: Line2

available.description: Hash of all cash balances available; represented in smallest currency unit

customer.description: The ID of the customer whose cash balance this object represents.

livemode.description: True for live mode; false for test mode
livemode.title: Livemode

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
object.title: Object

reconciliation_mode.description: Configuration for fund reconciliation: automatic or manual
